# Herzliya Pituach (הרצליה פיתוח) luxury villa market: research brief for "THE PRIVATE ESTATE"

Prepared 2026-09-16. Subject property as briefed (not verified by this research): plot of about 1.1 dunam (about 1,100 sqm), about 700 sqm built, 7 master suites, near the sea.

## 0. Read first: conventions and limits

- Every figure has a source link and a date. "Published" is the date shown by the source. Live pages that show no date (listings, municipal pages, Wikipedia) are marked "accessed 2026-09-16".
- "Derived" means simple arithmetic on figures in the cited source (price divided by area, or a difference). Derived per-sqm figures include the house, not land alone. Nothing here is an appraisal.
- Listing figures are asking prices or asking rents, not transactions.
- nadlan.gov.il was tried but is a JavaScript application that returned no data to the fetch tool (2026-09-16). Tax Authority figures below therefore come from press reports that cite Tax Authority data.
- Could not be fetched, and not retried by other means: TheMarker (robots.txt), he.wikipedia.org (cache-only), nevo.co.il (robots.txt), hamichlol.org.il (robots.txt), nta.co.il (HTTP 403), hmc.co.il (robots.txt fetch failed), wbais.org (domain did not resolve), a fs.knesset.gov.il PDF (HTTP 474), nadlanews.co.il (HTTP 503), one Globes Hebrew article (timeout, its English edition was used), one Madlan listing (HTTP 410).
- The session's web search quota (200 searches) ran out during the work. Open gaps are listed in section 9.
- Labels: FLAG = conflicting, dated or uncertain evidence. GAP = not found or not verifiable.

## 1. Geography, sub-areas, streets, character, diplomats, plot sizes

### 1.1 Location and character
- Herzliya Pituah is the western part of Herzliya, Tel Aviv District. English Wikipedia says it was established in 1925 and has "about 10,000 residents". FLAG: no year is given for the population. [Wikipedia: Herzliya Pituah](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Herzliya_Pituah), accessed 2026-09-16.
- Route 2 (coastal highway) is the eastern boundary of Herzliya Pituach. Herzliya city population: 110,884 (2024). [Wikipedia: Herzliya](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Herzliya), accessed 2026-09-16.
- Land uses: villas and luxury apartments, a beach hotel strip, the marina, and a high-tech zone in the southeast with local offices of Microsoft, Apple, SolarEdge, WeWork, Plarium and venture capital firms. [Wikipedia: Herzliya Pituah](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Herzliya_Pituah), accessed 2026-09-16.
- Madlan gives the neighborhood a socioeconomic index of 9/10. [Madlan neighborhood page](https://www.madlan.co.il/area-info/%D7%A9%D7%9B%D7%95%D7%A0%D7%94-%D7%94%D7%A8%D7%A6%D7%9C%D7%99%D7%94-%D7%A4%D7%99%D7%AA%D7%95%D7%97-%D7%94%D7%A8%D7%A6%D7%9C%D7%99%D7%94-%D7%99%D7%A9%D7%A8%D7%90%D7%9C), accessed 2026-09-16.
- ynet describes Galei Tchelet residents as established families plus newer tech entrepreneurs, with many owners living abroad and homes run by staff. [ynet](https://www.ynet.co.il/economy/article/r1om4ow9i), published 2023-01-06.

### 1.2 Sub-areas (names verified)
The approved Herzliya Seafront Plan divides the coast as follows, per [Mikumi](https://mikumi.co.il/real-estate-news/%D7%9E%D7%A1%D7%93%D7%99%D7%A8%D7%99%D7%9D-%D7%90%D7%AA-%D7%94%D7%99%D7%9D-%D7%91%D7%94%D7%A8%D7%A6%D7%9C%D7%99%D7%94-%D7%90%D7%95%D7%A9%D7%A8%D7%94-%D7%AA%D7%9B%D7%A0%D7%99%D7%AA-%D7%97%D7%96%D7%99/), published 2023-06-08:
- The plan covers 6 km along Herzliya's whole coastal strip.
- Northern section, about 1.5 km: Sidna Ali and Apollonia national parks.
- Central section, about 2.8 km: includes De Shalit Square and the descent to Sharon Beach, the Galei Tchelet neighborhood and Sidna Ali national park.
- Southern section, about 1.35 km: natural kurkar cliff of 16-18 m.

Other verified sub-areas and landmarks:
- Galei Tchelet (גלי תכלת): "located on a cliff adjacent to the beach in the north-western part of the neighborhood". [Wikipedia: Herzliya Pituah](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Herzliya_Pituah), accessed 2026-09-16.
- Nof Yam (נוף ים): an adjoining neighborhood. ynet placed a 2025 sale on HaEshel Street "on the border" between Nof Yam and Herzliya Pituach ([ynet](https://www.ynet.co.il/economy/article/yokra14636352), published 2026-01-08). Wikipedia lists "Sidna-'Ali Beach (Nof Yam)" ([Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Herzliya_Pituah), accessed 2026-09-16). FLAG: no official boundary map was fetched.
- Marina district: Arena mall is at HaShunit 2 ([Arena](https://www.arenamall.co.il/), accessed 2026-09-16), and The Ritz-Carlton Herzliya is at 4 HaShunit Street ([Ritz-Carlton](https://www.ritzcarlton.com/en/hotels/tlvrz-the-ritz-carlton-herzliya/overview/), accessed 2026-09-16). FLAG: HaShunit (השונית) is the marina's commercial street, not a villa street.
- Employment (high-tech) zone: 2025-2026 planning items are on Sapir Street ([Calcalist](https://www.calcalist.co.il/real-estate/article/s1vkzcmcxx), published 2025-10-20) and Medinat HaYehudim Street ([Nadlancenter](https://www.nadlancenter.co.il/article/13926), published 2026-02-15).
- South of the employment zone: the Southwest Quarter plan (Har/2200/A), bounded north by Abba Eban Street and the employment areas, east by Route 2 and the Ramat HaSharon boundary, south by the Tel Aviv boundary, and west by the kurkar cliff line ([plan instructions, land.gov.il](https://apps.land.gov.il/IturTabotData/takanonim-h/telmer/5050234.pdf), accessed 2026-09-16). Landowners promote it as "Hof HaTchelet" (Blue Coast), described as adjacent to Herzliya Marina ([Blue Coast association](https://www.bluecoast-herzliya.com/blue-cost-herzlia/), accessed 2026-09-16). It is a planning area, not an existing villa district (see 6.4).
- Southern Herzliya Pituach "east of the marina": new terraced and semi-detached houses on 330 sqm lots. [Globes English](https://en.globes.co.il/en/article-house-prices-in-new-herzliyah-project-skyrocket-1001466028), published 2023-12-25.
- Kfar Shmaryahu (כפר שמריהו) is a separate local council, not part of Herzliya: 2.57 sq km, 1,981 residents (2024), socio-economic ranking 10/10 ([Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kfar_Shmaryahu), accessed 2026-09-16). It competes for the same villa buyers. To reach Apollonia National Park you turn toward Herzliya Pituach at the Kfar Shmaryahu junction, then onto Wingate Street ([Israel Nature and Parks Authority](https://en.parks.org.il/reserve-park/apollonia-national-park-tel-arsuf/), accessed 2026-09-16).

### 1.3 Prestige streets
- Galei Tchelet: English Wikipedia calls it "the most expensive street in Israel" and "home to the residences of several foreign ambassadors" ([Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Herzliya_Pituah), accessed 2026-09-16).
  - ynet: about 900 m long, "about 80 properties". Early buyers bought building plots of half a dunam to 1.5 dunams. Only five deals on the street in the previous decade. Broker commission 1%-3% per deal. [ynet](https://www.ynet.co.il/economy/article/r1om4ow9i), published 2023-01-06.
  - N12: about 60 villas, about half directly on the cliff line on the western side with open sea views. Western villas cost "double or more" than eastern-side villas. Several deals on the street crossed NIS 100 million. [N12 / mako](https://www.mako.co.il/news-money/real_estate/Article-bfa376217146b91027.htm), published 2025-12-28.
  - FLAG: "about 80 properties" (2023) and "about 60 villas" (2025) do not match; the sources count differently.
- Streets with recorded villa sales or current villa listings (evidence of villa activity, not a ranking): HaEshel, Shlomtzion HaMalka, HaShikma, Shevet Menashe, Eliezer Kaplan, HaNasi Yitzhak Ben Zvi, Shlomo HaMelech, Basel, Klausner, Baruch Kamin, Kidma, Levi Eshkol, Achi Dakar, Lehi, Wingate, David HaMelech, Arie Ben Eliezer, HaNuriot. Sources are in sections 2 and 3.
- GAP: "Nachshon" as a prestige villa street was not found in any source.

### 1.4 Embassies and ambassadors
- "55 ambassadors live in Herzliya" per Herzliya Municipality data. [Calcalist](https://www.calcalist.co.il/real-estate/article/s1vkzcmcxx), published 2025-10-20. Same figure in [Globes](https://www.globes.co.il/news/article.aspx?did=1001524267) (date not displayed). FLAG: this is a citywide figure, not a Herzliya Pituach count.
- Former US ambassador's residence: Galei Tchelet 40, built in the early 1960s with later additions, about 1,000 sqm built on just over 5,000 sqm of land. [Globes English](https://en.globes.co.il/en/article-is-the-us-ambassadors-herzliya-residence-worth-87m-1001334837), published 2020-07-06.
- After agreeing to sell it to Sheldon Adelson, the US arranged for the ambassador's family to stay on as tenants until spring 2021. [Globes English](https://en.globes.co.il/en/article-us-ambassador-to-rent-herzliya-residence-from-adelson-1001341907), published 2020-09-07.
- UAE embassy: on 2025-10-20 the Tel Aviv District Planning Committee decided to deposit a plan for a permanent embassy at 9 Sapir Street in the Herzliya employment zone. The plot is about 2.5 dunams, with up to 15,000 sqm on 15 floors, offices, and homes for the ambassador and staff. [Calcalist](https://www.calcalist.co.il/real-estate/article/s1vkzcmcxx), published 2025-10-20. Globes adds a land value of about NIS 160 million and up to 20% of the building rights for ambassador and staff housing. [Globes](https://www.globes.co.il/news/article.aspx?did=1001524267), date not displayed (FLAG).

### 1.5 Typical plot sizes (sourced examples)
- Galei Tchelet west side, appraiser's comparables: plots of 1,018 to 1,277 sqm. [Globes English](https://en.globes.co.il/en/article-is-the-us-ambassadors-herzliya-residence-worth-87m-1001334837), published 2020-07-06.
- Galei Tchelet early plots: half a dunam to 1.5 dunams. [ynet](https://www.ynet.co.il/economy/article/r1om4ow9i), published 2023-01-06.
- Many older houses for sale in western Herzliya sit on 0.5-dunam lots. [Globes English](https://en.globes.co.il/en/article-no-takers-for-houses-in-herzliya-pituah-1001278569), published 2019-03-18. FLAG: dated, and "western part of the city" may be wider than Pituach.
- Entry-level villa sales: plots of 280 and 400 sqm. [Bizportal](https://www.bizportal.co.il/realestates/news/article/813079), published 2023-03-24.
- New terraced and semi-detached houses east of the marina: 330 sqm lots. [Globes English](https://en.globes.co.il/en/article-house-prices-in-new-herzliyah-project-skyrocket-1001466028), published 2023-12-25.
- Large estates: 9,500 sqm (Abramovich estate) ([Globes English](https://en.globes.co.il/en/article-exclusive-roman-abramovich-buys-herzliya-home-for-nis-226m-1001330878), published 2020-06-01), just over 5,000 sqm (Galei Tchelet 40) ([Globes English](https://en.globes.co.il/en/article-is-the-us-ambassadors-herzliya-residence-worth-87m-1001334837), published 2020-07-06), 2 dunams (HaEshel, Ori Allon) ([Calcalist](https://www.calcalist.co.il/local_news/article/rkqisruct), published 2022-02-03).
- What this means for the subject (no price implied): a plot of about 1,100 sqm is in the same size range as the Galei Tchelet west-side comparables and about twice the 0.5-dunam lot of an older house.

## 2. Market data

### 2.1 Aggregates
- 2025, deals above NIS 20 million in Herzliya: 8 deals, all in Herzliya Pituach, worth NIS 220 million, NIS 19 million less than in 2024. The most expensive was a NIS 37 million marina apartment. [Calcalist](https://www.calcalist.co.il/real-estate/article/sjrqmo7lmx), published 2026-05-27. Derived: about NIS 239 million for such deals in 2024. FLAG: the 8 deals include apartments; no source split out villas for 2025.
- 2022, Herzliya: 157 deals above NIS 5 million (Tax Authority data). [Nadlancenter](https://www.nadlancenter.co.il/article/7017), published 2023-01-11.

[Globes English](https://en.globes.co.il/en/article-house-prices-in-new-herzliyah-project-skyrocket-1001466028), published 2023-12-25.

### 2.4 Price per dunam and per built sqm: what the sources support
- GAP: no 2024-2026 source found gives a land price per dunam for villa plots in Herzliya Pituach.
- Most recent published land benchmark: about NIS 65,000 per sqm of land on the Galei Tchelet west side ([Globes English](https://en.globes.co.il/en/article-is-the-us-ambassadors-herzliya-residence-worth-87m-1001334837), published 2020-07-06). Derived: about NIS 65m per dunam. FLAG: dated, and specific to that street side.
- Older, wider benchmark: land "usually NIS 5-6 million for a half-dunam lot" under old houses in the western part of Herzliya ([Globes English](https://en.globes.co.il/en/article-no-takers-for-houses-in-herzliya-pituah-1001278569), published 2019-03-18). FLAG: dated, and may cover more than Pituach.
- Derived from sales (house value included):
  - HaShikma, 2024: about NIS 43,300 per plot sqm, about NIS 71,800 per built sqm.
  - Shlomtzion HaMalka, 2025: about NIS 66,000 per built sqm.
  - HaEshel (Ori Allon), 2022: NIS 90,000 per plot sqm, NIS 180,000 per built sqm (Calcalist's own figure).
  - Galei Tchelet 66, reported 2023: about NIS 135,500 per plot sqm on 1,277 sqm, or about NIS 173,000 per plot sqm if the plot is "about 1 dunam". FLAG: plot size uncertain.
- Takeaway: per-sqm prices vary several times over with cliff-line position and sea view (N12: western Galei Tchelet villas cost "double or more" than eastern ones). A licensed appraiser (שמאי מקרקעין) should value the subject. The figures above are not a valuation.

### 2.5 Current asking prices (listings, not deals)
- Madlan shows "137 בתים פרטיים למכירה" (137 private houses for sale) in Herzliya Pituach. Visible examples: lowest NIS 8.5m (4.5 rooms, 150 sqm, HaNasi Yitzhak Ben Zvi); NIS 42m (9 rooms, 550 sqm, Baruch Kamin); NIS 50,000,000 shown next to NIS 60,000,000 (possibly a price cut; 7 rooms, 750 sqm, Arie Ben Eliezer); NIS 59m (8 rooms, 766 sqm, HaNuriot 24); NIS 80m (9 rooms, 800 sqm); NIS 97m (8 rooms, 1,200 sqm, Kaplan). [Madlan](https://www.madlan.co.il/villas-for-sale/%D7%A9%D7%9B%D7%95%D7%A0%D7%94-%D7%94%D7%A8%D7%A6%D7%9C%D7%99%D7%94-%D7%A4%D7%99%D7%AA%D7%95%D7%97-%D7%94%D7%A8%D7%A6%D7%9C%D7%99%D7%94-%D7%99%D7%A9%D7%A8%D7%90%D7%9C), accessed 2026-09-16. FLAG: asking prices only, and Madlan's sqm field may be built or plot area.
- Competing luxury apartments: Ofer Investments is building a 76-dunam project on Abba Eban Street. In 2025 a 210 sqm apartment on the 9th floor of a 12-storey building there sold for NIS 21.4m ([N12](https://www.mako.co.il/news-money/real_estate/Article-bfa376217146b91027.htm), published 2025-12-28). Madlan also shows new-build "Pituach on the Sea" (פיתוח על הים) apartment sales of NIS 12m for 147 sqm, 4 rooms (2026-03-22) and NIS 11.78m for 140 sqm, 4 rooms (2026-03-31) ([Madlan, Galei Tchelet street page](https://www.madlan.co.il/street-info/%D7%92%D7%9C%D7%99-%D7%AA%D7%9B%D7%9C%D7%AA-%D7%94%D7%A8%D7%A6%D7%9C%D7%99%D7%94-%D7%99%D7%A9%D7%A8%D7%90%D7%9C), accessed 2026-09-16).

## 3. Rental market

- Madlan shows "39 בתים פרטיים להשכרה" (39 private houses for rent) in Herzliya Pituach, at monthly prices. Large homes: NIS 170,000 (9 rooms, 1,200 sqm); NIS 160,000 (10 rooms, 2,000 sqm); NIS 150,000 (8 rooms, 1,800 sqm); NIS 140,000 (5 rooms, 600 sqm, David HaMelech); NIS 120,000 (9 rooms, 550 sqm); NIS 95,000 (7 rooms, 930 sqm); NIS 90,000 (8 rooms, 650 sqm); NIS 80,000 (8 rooms, 500 sqm, HaEshel); NIS 70,000 (9 rooms, 350 sqm, Hannah Meron 6). ## 6. Planning and risks

### 6.1 Herzliya Seafront Plan, Har/2202 (plan 504-0467118)
- The Tel Aviv District Planning Committee gave the plan final approval ("למתן תוקף"). It covers 6 km of coast and provides for significant beach widening with detached breakwaters and coastal promenades. [Mikumi](https://mikumi.co.il/real-estate-news/%D7%9E%D7%A1%D7%93%D7%99%D7%A8%D7%99%D7%9D-%D7%90%D7%AA-%D7%94%D7%99%D7%9D-%D7%91%D7%94%D7%A8%D7%A6%D7%9C%D7%99%D7%94-%D7%90%D7%95%D7%A9%D7%A8%D7%94-%D7%AA%D7%9B%D7%A0%D7%99%D7%AA-%D7%97%D7%96%D7%99/), published 2023-06-08.
- The plan instructions give an area of 3,017.7 dunams. The stated goal is to preserve, develop and restore the coastal strip, with conservation beaches, moderate urban development and intensive development zones (section 2.1). Cliff works include "soft" measures (drainage, planting, nets, rock anchors) and hard engineering such as retaining walls. [Plan instructions, land.gov.il](https://apps.land.gov.il/IturTabotData/takanonim/telmer/5050235.pdf), accessed 2026-09-16. FLAG: Mynet called it a 3,600-dunam plan ([Mynet](https://herzliya.mynet.co.il/real_estate/article/rystfbud2), published 2023-06-15).
- Promenade next to private villas: a 6 m pedestrian right of way was approved along the western part of the Galei Tchelet 40 garden for the cliff-top promenade ([Calcalist](https://www.calcalist.co.il/real-estate/article/sy1w3sjuh), published 2023-06-05). The strip is about 400 sqm ([Mynet](https://herzliya.mynet.co.il/real_estate/article/rystfbud2), published 2023-06-15). For a buyer: check the plan sheets for any easement or promenade line on the subject plot.
- State Comptroller follow-up audit: the Seafront Plan was approved after about a decade of delays, but the municipality "has yet to advance the planning and construction of the land protections". [State Comptroller](https://library.mevaker.gov.il/sites/DigitalLibrary/Documents/2024/Shilton/EN/2024-Shilton-501-Matzok-EN.pdf), published July 2024.

### 6.2 Cliff erosion
- Geological Survey of Israel report 13/2025: the Ga'ash segment (Wingate to Herzliya) is 10 km long with an average cliff height of 29 m. It recorded 77 collapse events and about 12,778 cubic m of collapse over 2023-2024, out of 236 events nationally across 7 segments. The report does not analyze Herzliya separately. [GSI](https://www.gov.il/BlobFolder/reports/mushkin-et-al-2025/he/report_GSI%2013%202025.pdf), published May 2025.
- State Comptroller: "in the authorities of Hadera, Herzliya, and Gan Raveh, no protections have been implemented at all". There was also no solution yet for sea protection north of Sidna Ali. [State Comptroller](https://library.mevaker.gov.il/sites/DigitalLibrary/Documents/2024/Shilton/EN/2024-Shilton-501-Matzok-EN.pdf), published July 2024.
- Calcalist: the Herzliya cliff collapsed twice in the preceding month. The mayor asked the Finance Ministry for about NIS 150m to protect Herzliya's kurkar cliffs, citing "immediate danger to life". The coastal authorities forum estimated that Herzliya and Hadera together need about NIS 300m. About NIS 410m promised for marine protection had not been transferred. [Calcalist](https://www.calcalist.co.il/local_news/article/b1v9jkfbkx), published 2024-12-25.
- Sharonline:
  - The collapses were at Sidna Ali beach and north of Sharon beach.
  - On 2025-01-08 the local planning committee approved the land-side cliff protection plan for all of Herzliya's beaches. It then goes to the Environmental Protection Ministry and the coastal committee (VALHOF).
  - The municipality again asked Galei Tchelet residents, who "sit right on the cliff", to block access toward the cliff and take care of their yards.
  - Until the plan is approved, the city is limited to fencing, signs and drainage.

  [Sharonline](https://sharonline.co.il/local-news/%D7%94%D7%A6%D7%94%D7%A8%D7%95%D7%AA-%D7%AA%D7%95%D7%9B%D7%A0%D7%99%D7%95%D7%AA-%D7%95%D7%A2%D7%93%D7%95%D7%AA-%D7%A9%D7%9C%D7%90-%D7%9E%D7%AA%D7%9B%D7%A0%D7%A1%D7%95%D7%AA-%D7%95%D7%91%D7%A9/), published 2025-01-09.
- The government cliff protection company's Galei Tchelet page says there is urban construction on and close to the cliff top. Its approach: restrict public access, divert drainage from private plots eastward, and widen the beach. [MCCP](https://www.mccp.co.il/page.php?type=page&id=2560&ht=%D7%94%D7%A8%D7%A6%D7%9C%D7%99%D7%94+%D7%92%D7%9C%D7%99+%D7%AA%D7%9B%D7%9C%D7%AA&bmb=1917), no date shown.
- Calcalist, citing the State Comptroller: the Herzliya marina and three detached breakwaters north of it caused the shoreline to retreat along a stretch of up to about 2 km. [Calcalist](https://www.calcalist.co.il/real-estate/article/sjqs11dmkk), published 2021-11-30.
- For a buyer: if the plot is on the cliff line, get a geotechnical opinion on the cliff and ask the municipality where the protection plan stands before marketing sea-edge features.

### 6.3 Coastal Environment Protection Law 2004 (חוק שמירת הסביבה החופית)
From the unofficial English translation on gov.il ([gov.il PDF](https://www.gov.il/BlobFolder/legalinfo/coastal_environment_protection_law_2004/en/marine_coastal_environment_protection_of_coastal_environment_law_2004_eng_unofficial_translation.pdf), accessed 2026-09-16; section numbers as they appear in that translation):
- "Coastal environment": 300 m inland from the coastline, plus the sea out to the limit of territorial waters.
- "Seacoast area": 100 m inland from the coastline, plus the seaward area.
- The whole seacoast area is an open public right of way (section 5).
- A plan that applies to the coastal environment cannot be deposited or approved without the Committee for the Protection of the Coastal Environment (VALHOF). The exception is a detailed plan that follows a local outline plan the Committee has already approved. Permits for non-conforming use in the coastal environment also need the Committee.
- Permits with height reliefs in the coastal environment need the Committee's approval, subject to exceptions in the schedule.
- Approvals, permits and plans that were valid before the law took effect are not affected (section 20).
- FLAG: press shorthand says building within 300 m of the sea is banned ([ynet](https://www.ynet.co.il/economy/article/r1om4ow9i), 2023-01-06; [ynetnews](https://www.ynetnews.com/magazine/article/h1t6gubb3), 2023-03-31). The translation does not set a blanket 300 m ban; it sets approval requirements. TAMA 13 (the national coastal outline plan) was not reviewed. Get a planning lawyer's opinion for the specific plot.
- For a buyer: if the plot is within 300 m of the legal coastline, a new plan, height relief or non-conforming use may need VALHOF approval. A licensed surveyor should confirm the distance.

### 6.4 Development pressure near the villa area
- Herzliya's employment zone is expected to get "6,000 housing units" in the coming years ([Nadlancenter](https://www.nadlancenter.co.il/article/13926), published 2026-02-15; about 6,000 small units also in [Calcalist](https://www.calcalist.co.il/real-estate/article/ry1e0jl1a), published 2023-09-19).
- Herzliya's planning subcommittee approved a 30-storey tower at 103 Medinat HaYehudim Street, replacing Ackerstein House. It will have about 25,000 sqm of offices plus retail, 47 homes averaging 50 sqm, and 12 affordable units. [Nadlancenter](https://www.nadlancenter.co.il/article/13926), published 2026-02-15.
- The local committee approved Gav-Yam's "Science Park" (Har/Mak/2443): about 24 dunams, 392 micro-apartments of about 50 sqm, about 138,000 sqm above ground, and buildings of up to 15 floors. [Nadlancenter](https://www.nadlancenter.co.il/article/13956), published 2026-02-18.
- UAE embassy of 15 floors at 9 Sapir Street (see 1.4).
- Southwest Quarter, Har/2200/A: plan area 1,985.774 dunams and 12,500 housing units. Residential permits require detailed plans first. [Plan instructions, land.gov.il](https://apps.land.gov.il/IturTabotData/takanonim-h/telmer/5050234.pdf), accessed 2026-09-16. FLAG: the machine-read PDF text mentions 12 and 8 floors in its height rules, but the context is unclear; check the official plan. Calcalist reported about 12,000 units on about 2,000 dunams, no detailed planning, and no construction expected soon ([Calcalist](https://www.calcalist.co.il/real-estate/article/ry1e0jl1a), published 2023-09-19). The Blue Coast association of private landowners cites more than 2,100 dunams and about 11,000 units ([Blue Coast](https://www.bluecoast-herzliya.com/blue-cost-herzlia/), accessed 2026-09-16).
- GAP: no current source was found on marina expansion.
- GAP: no source was found on towers approved inside the Galei Tchelet villa area. Buyers should still check plans in preparation on the planning portal.

[Herzliya Municipality](https://www.herzliya.muni.il/%D7%91%D7%99%D7%A8%D7%95%D7%A8-%D7%94%D7%99%D7%98%D7%9C%D7%99-%D7%A4%D7%99%D7%AA%D7%95%D7%97-%D7%9E%D7%92%D7%95%D7%A8%D7%99%D7%9D/), accessed 2026-09-16.
- GAP: no verified source for villa maintenance, private security, gardening or pool running costs.

## 8. Buyer due diligence for a villa in Israel

Land and title
- The Israel Land Authority manages 93% of the land in Israel. The rest is private or held by religious bodies. Urban land was leased for 49 years with an option for another 49. A 2009 reform provided for converting long-term urban residential leases into ownership. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Israel_Land_Administration), accessed 2026-09-16.
- Herzliya was founded in 1925 on land bought by the American Zion Commonwealth, which sold plots to private buyers in the US and Poland. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/American_Zion_Commonwealth), accessed 2026-09-16. FLAG: this history does not tell you how a particular Pituach plot is registered today.
- Order a land registry extract (נסח טאבו) for the block and parcel. It shows registered owners, mortgages, liens, court orders and restrictions. [gov.il](https://www.gov.il/he/service/land_registration_extract), updated 2025-12-14. If the land is managed by the ILA, get an ILA rights confirmation (אישור זכויות). [Nadlancenter guide](https://www.nadlancenter.co.il/article/2775), updated 2024-10-15.

Permits, deviations and remaining rights
- Compare the building as it stands with the approved plans in the municipal building file. Check the applicable plans (תב"ע) and plans in preparation on the Planning Administration portal (mavat.iplan.gov.il). [Nadlancenter guide](https://www.nadlancenter.co.il/article/2775), updated 2024-10-15.
- Herzliya's engineering department handles building permits, additions, completion certificates (form 4), betterment levy and outline plans. [Herzliya Municipality](https://www.herzliya.muni.il/%D7%9E%D7%99%D7%A0%D7%94%D7%9C-%D7%94%D7%A0%D7%93%D7%A1%D7%94/), accessed 2026-09-16.
- Remaining building rights (יתרת זכויות): get the municipal planning information and a rights calculation from an architect or appraiser. Near the sea, additional rights or height reliefs may need VALHOF approval (6.3).

Betterment levy (היטל השבחה)
- Kol Zchut: the levy is usually half of the increase in value created by a plan approval, a relief (הקלה) or a non-conforming use, and is usually paid on sale. [Kol Zchut](https://www.kolzchut.org.il/he/%D7%94%D7%99%D7%98%D7%9C_%D7%94%D7%A9%D7%91%D7%97%D7%94), updated 2023-11-29.
- Herzliya lets you request betterment levy information for a property. [Herzliya Municipality](https://www.herzliya.muni.il/%D7%91%D7%A7%D7%A9%D7%94-%D7%9C%D7%91%D7%A8%D7%95%D7%A8-%D7%9E%D7%99%D7%93%D7%A2-%D7%94%D7%99%D7%98%D7%9C-%D7%94%D7%A9%D7%91%D7%97%D7%94/), accessed 2026-09-16. The sale contract should say who pays any levy.

Basement and pool
- GAP: no verified Herzliya rule was found on living use of basements or on pool permits. Check that the basement's use and the pool appear in the permit and completion documents, and ask the municipality in writing. Do not present unpermitted features as rights in marketing.

Coast and cliff
- Check the distance to the legal coastline (6.3), any promenade easement (6.1), and exposure to the cliff, including drainage and access duties (6.2).

Price evidence
- Tax Authority transaction data and appraisal decisions are public resources that a buyer's appraiser will use. [Nadlancenter guide](https://www.nadlancenter.co.il/article/2775), updated 2024-10-15.

## 9. Gaps and uncertainty register
1. Few verified villa sales for 2024-2026: three sales plus one headline. No land price per dunam for 2024-2026.
2. nadlan.gov.il could not be read by the tool, and TheMarker could not be fetched (the 2026-05-22 NIS 14m sale is headline only).
3. Conflicting figures: the Galei Tchelet 40 price (NIS 300m, about NIS 250m, NIS 230.35m), the Galei Tchelet 66 plot size (about 1 dunam or 1,277 sqm), and which sale holds the record.
4. Galei Tchelet size: about 80 properties (ynet 2023) against about 60 villas (N12 2025).
5. No 2026 arnona rates and no verified holding-cost data.
6. No verified Herzliya rules on basement use or pool permits.
7. Rental data are asking rents only; no signed villa or diplomatic leases.
8. Not verified: school zoning for the estate's address, WBAIS logistics, Herzliya Medical Center's address.
9. Not verified: Green Line station locations in Herzliya and the marina expansion status.
10. Distances are straight-line from a neighborhood reference point, not from the estate.
11. The web search quota ran out. More searching could target items 1, 5, 6, 8 and 9.

## 10. Notes for the listing copy (drawn from the findings above)
- Claims backed by sources: a seaside neighborhood with Apollonia and Sidna Ali national parks on the northern coast; the marina and Arena mall; Reichman University and the high-tech district nearby; 55 ambassadors living in Herzliya (municipal data, citywide); the Green Line scheduled to reach Herzliya in 2030.
- Avoid or qualify:
  - "Israel's most expensive street", unless the estate is on Galei Tchelet.
  - Any "record" claim.
  - Fixed drive times.
  - "Protected sea view", given planning changes and cliff works.
  - The light rail as a current amenity.
  - Any statement about building rights, basement or pool that permits do not back up.
- Measure every distance from the estate's exact address before publishing.
